Why? Because I do not love you? Elohim knows.
But this that I do I will also do, that I may cut off the occasion of those who seek an occasion, so that in that thing in which they boast they may be found even as we.
For these are false apostles, crafty workers, and they make themselves like the apostles of the Mashiyach.
And there is nothing to wonder at in this. For if Satana makes himself like a messenger of light,
it is no great thing if his servants also make themselves like servants of righteousness; their end will be according to their works.
Again I say, let no one think of me as a fool; or if not, receive me even as a fool, so that I too may boast a little.
What I am ‹now› saying, I am not saying in our Master, but as in folly, in this matter of boasting.
Because many boast in the flesh, I also will boast.
For you yourselves put up with listening to those who lack understanding, since you are wise.

And you put up with the one who puts you in bondage, and with the one who eats you up, and with the one who takes from you, and with the one who lifts himself over you, and with the one who strikes you on your face.
I speak as if in disgrace—as if we were weak. In lack of understanding I say that in whatever anyone is bold, I also am bold.
If they are Hebrews, so am I. If they are Israelites, so am I. If they are the seed of Avraham, so am I.
If they are ministers of the Mashiyach—in lack of understanding I say it—I am more than they: in labors more than they, in stripes more than they, in bonds more than they, in deaths many times.
From the Yehudaye five times I received forty ‹stripes› less one.
Three times I was beaten with rods; one time I was stoned; three times I was shipwrecked; a day and a night I was in the sea without a ship.

In many journeys, in danger from rivers, in danger from robbers, in danger from my kindred, in danger from the peoples; I have been in danger in the city, I have been in danger in the wilderness, in danger in the sea, in danger from false brothers.
In toil and in weariness, in much watching, in hunger and in thirst, in much fasting, in cold and in nakedness.
besides the rest, and the thronging upon me every day, and my care for all the assemblies.
Who is weak, and I am not weak? Who is stumbled, and I do not burn?
If I must boast, I will boast in my weaknesses.
Elohim, the Father of our Master Y'shua the Mashiyach, blessed forever and ever, knows that I do not lie.
In Darmasuq the chief of the force of Artus the king was guarding the city of the Darmasuqaye to seize me.
And from a window in a basket they let me down from the wall, and I escaped from his hands.
Boasting is needed, yet it is not profitable; so I come to visions and revelations of our Master.
I know a man in the Mashiyach fourteen years ago—whether in the body or out of the body I do not know, Elohim knows—who was caught up as far as the third heaven.
And I know this same man—whether in the body or out of the body I do not know, Elohim knows—
that he was caught up to Paradise and heard words that are not spoken, which it is not permitted for a man to speak.
Of this one I will boast, but of myself I will not boast, except in weaknesses.
For if I should want to boast, I would not be a fool, for I am speaking the truth; yet I hold back, so that no one may think of me beyond what he sees in me and hears from me.
And so that I would not be lifted up by the excellence of the revelations, a thorn in my flesh was given to me, a messenger of Satana to buffet me, so that I would not be lifted up.
Concerning this I asked my Master three times that it would depart from me.
And he said to me, My grace is enough for you, for my power is perfected in weakness. Gladly therefore I will boast in my weaknesses, so that the power of the Mashiyach may rest on me.
Because of this I take pleasure in weaknesses, in insults, in distresses, in persecutions, in imprisonments, for the sake of the Mashiyach; for when I am weak, then I am strong.
I have become foolish in my boasting, for you compelled me. For you ought to have borne witness for me, because I was inferior in nothing to those apostles who excel more, even though I was nothing.
The signs of an apostle I worked among you with all patience, and with mighty deeds, and with wonders, and with power.
For in what were you made inferior to the other assemblies, except only in this, that I was not a burden to you? Forgive me this folly.

This is the third time I am ready to come to you, and I will not be a burden to you, because I do not seek what is yours but you. For children are not bound to lay up a store for the parents, but the parents for their children.
But I will gladly spend and be spent, and even give my own self for the sake of your souls, even though the more I love you, the less you love me.
But perhaps I was not a burden to you, yet like a crafty man I took you by deceit.
Did I take advantage of you through any other person whom I sent to you?
I asked Titus, and I sent the brother with him. Did Titus take anything from you? Did we not walk in the same spirit and in the same steps?
Do you again suppose that we are making a defense to you? Before Elohim, in the Mashiyach we speak; and all these things, my beloved, ‹are› for the sake of your building up.

For I fear lest I come to you and not find you as I wish, and I also be found by you as you do not wish; lest ‹there be› contention and envy and anger and obstinacy and slander and murmuring and insolence and commotion;
lest when I come to you my Elohim humble me, and I mourn over many who have sinned and have not repented of the impurity and the whoredom and the lasciviousness which they have committed.
This is the third time I am coming to you; that by the mouth of two and three witnesses every word will stand.

I said to you beforehand, and again I am saying beforehand to you, as also the two times I was with you I said to you, and even now while I am far away I write to those who have sinned and to the rest of the others, that if I come again I will not spare:
because you have sought a proof of the Mashiyach who speaks in me, who is not weak among you, but is powerful among you.
For even if he was crucified in weakness, yet he lives by the power of Elohim. And we also are weak with him, yet we live with him by the power of Elohim that is among you.
Test yourselves, whether you stand in the faith; examine yourselves. Or do you not recognize that Y'shua the Mashiyach is in you? And if ‹he is› not, you are rejected.
But I trust that you will know that we are not rejected.
But I ask from Elohim that nothing bad may be in you, so that our proof may appear, yet that you may be doers of good, and we may be as rejected ones.
For we are not able to do anything against the truth, but ‹only› for the truth.
And we rejoice when we are weak and you are strong. For this also we pray, that you may be perfected.

For this reason, while I am far away, I write these things, so that when I come I may not act severely, according to the authority my Master gave me for your building up and not for your tearing down.
From now on, my brothers, rejoice and be perfected and be comforted, and may harmony and peace be among you; and the Elohim of love and of peace will be with you.
Greet one another with a holy kiss.
All the saints ask for your peace.
The peace of our Master Y'shua the Mashiyach, and the love of Elohim, and the fellowship of the Ruach haKodesh, be with all of you. Amen.
Paulos, a sent one, not from the sons of men and not by the hand of a son of man, but by the hand of Y'shua the Mashiyach and Elohim his Father, he who raised him from the house of the dead;
and all the brothers who are with me, to the assembly that is in Galatia.
Grace be with you and peace from Elohim the Father and from our Master Y'shua the Mashiyach,
he who gave his soul in place of our sins, that he might free us from this evil world, according to the will of Elohim our Father,
to whom be glory to the age of ages. Amen.
I marvel how quickly you are turning from the Mashiyach, he who called you by his grace, to another good news;
which is not, except there are some who trouble you and want to change the gospel of the Mashiyach.
But even if we, or a messenger from heaven, should announce to you differently from what we announced to you, let him be accursed.
As I said from the first, and now again I say, that if anyone announces to you differently from what you received, let him be accursed.
For do I now persuade the sons of men, or Elohim? Or do I seek to please the sons of men? For if until now I had pleased the sons of men, I would not have been a servant of the Mashiyach.
But I make known to you, my brothers, that the gospel announced by me was not from a son of man.
For I did not receive it from a son of man, nor learn it, but ‹I had it› by revelation of Y'shua the Mashiyach.
For you have heard of my former way of life in Judaism, that I was exceedingly persecuting the assembly of Elohim and was destroying it.
And I was advancing in Judaism far beyond many of my own age who were of my nation, and was exceedingly zealous for the teachings of my fathers.
But when he who separated me from my mother's womb and called me by his grace was pleased,
to reveal his Son in me, that I might proclaim him among the peoples, at once I did not disclose it to flesh and blood,
nor did I go to Urishlim to the apostles who were before me, but I went away to Arabia and returned again to Darmasuq.
And after three years I went to Urishlim to see Keefa, and I stayed with him fifteen days.
But of the other apostles I saw none, except Ya'akov the brother of our Master.
Now these things that I write to you, before Elohim, I am not lying.
After these things I came to the regions of Syria and of Cilicia.
And the assemblies in Yehuda that are in the Mashiyach did not know me by face.
But this only they were hearing, that he who formerly was persecuting us now proclaims the faith that he formerly was overthrowing.
And they were glorifying Elohim in me.
Then again after fourteen years I went up to Urishlim with Bar-Naba, and I took Titus with me.

And I went up by revelation, and I laid open to them the good news that I proclaim among the peoples, and I showed it privately to those who were considered something, lest somehow I had run or am running in vain.
But not even Titus who was with me, being an Aramean, was compelled to be circumcised.
But because of the false brothers who slipped in to spy out our freedom that we have in Y'shua the Mashiyach, so that they might bring us into bondage;
we did not yield in subjection to them even for an hour, that the truth of the good news might remain with you.
But from those who were considered to be something—whatever they were makes no difference to me; Elohim does not receive the face of men—those ones added nothing to me.
But otherwise; for they saw that I was entrusted with the good news of the uncircumcision, as Keefa was entrusted with the circumcision.
For he who worked with Keefa in the apostleship of the circumcision also worked with me in the apostleship of the Gentiles.

And when they knew the grace that was given to me, Ya'akov and Keefa and Yochanan, those who were considered to be pillars, gave the right hand of fellowship to me and to Bar-Naba, that we ‹should labor› among the Gentiles, and they among the circumcision.
Only ‹they desired› that we would remember the needy; and I was eager to do this very thing.
But when Keefa came to Antiokia, I rebuked him to his face, because they were stumbling because of him.

and filled with the fruits of righteousness that are through Y'shua the Mashiyach, to the glory and honor of Elohim.
But I want you to know, my brothers, that my affairs have rather come forward for the gospel;
so that my bonds in the Mashiyach have become known in all the praetorium and to all the rest.
And many of the brothers in our Master have grown confident because of my bonds and are far more bold to speak the word of Elohim without fear.
And some from envy and contention, but others with good will and with love, herald ‹it› to the Mashiyach;
because they know that I am set for the defense of the gospel.
But those who herald the Mashiyach out of contention do it not sincerely, but hope to add affliction to my bonds.
And in this I have rejoiced and do rejoice, that in every way, whether in pretence or in truth, the Mashiyach is heralded.
For I know that these things will be found ‹conducive› to my life through your prayers and through the gift of the spirit of Y'shua the Mashiyach.
So that I hope and expect that in nothing I will be put to shame, but with uncovered face, as at all times, so now also the Mashiyach will be magnified in my body, whether by life or by death.
For my life is the Mashiyach, and if I die it is gain to me.
But if I also have fruit in this life of the flesh in my work, I do not know what I will choose for myself.
For the two press upon me: I desire to depart, that I may be with the Mashiyach, and this would be far better for me.
But also remaining in my body is necessary for me because of you.
And this I confidently know, that I remain and continue for your joy and for the growth of your faith;
so that when I come again to you, your boasting which is in Y'shua the Mashiyach alone will abound through me.

Only conduct yourselves as is fitting for the good news of the Mashiyach, so that whether I come and see you or am away I may hear of you, that you stand in one spirit and in one soul and strive together in the faith of the good news.
And in nothing be you shaken by those who stand against us; ‹which is› a sign of their destruction and of life for you.
And this from Elohim is given to you, that not only you believe in the Mashiyach, but also that you suffer on his account;
and that you endure the contest as you have seen in me and now hear concerning me.
If therefore you have consolation in the Mashiyach, and if a fullness of heart in love, and if fellowship of the spirit, and if affection and mercies;
complete my joy, that one mind may be yours, and one love, and one soul, and one purpose.
And do nothing in strife or in empty glory, but in lowliness of mind let each one consider his companion as better than himself.
And let no one be careful ‹only› for his own self, but each one also for his companion.
And think this in your souls, that which also Y'shua the Mashiyach ‹thought›;
who, when he was in the likeness of Elohim, did not consider it robbery that he is the equal of Elohim;
but he emptied himself and took the likeness of a servant, and was in the likeness of the sons of men, and in fashion was found as a man
and he humbled himself and became obedient as far as death, even the death of the cross.
Because of this, Elohim also highly exalted him and gave him a name that is more excellent than all names,
that at the name of Y'shua every knee should bow, of ‹beings› in heaven, and on earth, and under the earth;
and every tongue should confess that Master YHWH is Y'shua the Mashiyach, to the glory of Elohim his Father.
Therefore, my beloved, as you have at all times obeyed, not only when I am near to you, but now when I am far from you, work the work of your life more abundantly with fear and with trembling.
For Elohim is working in you both to will and to perform that which you desire.
Do everything without murmuring and without contention;
that you may be perfect and without blemish, as the pure children of Elohim who dwell in a hard and crooked generation; and appear among them as lights in the world;
so that you may be to them in place of life, for my glorying in the day of the Mashiyach, that I did not run in vain or toil for nothing.
But even if I am poured out on the sacrifice and service of your faith, I rejoice and exult with all of you.
So also you rejoice and exult with me.
But I hope in our Master Y'shua that I will soon send Timotheos to you, so that I also may have rest when I learn about you.
For I have no other one here who is like my own soul, who will carefully care for what is yours.
For they all seek their own, and not the ‹things› of Y'shua the Mashiyach.
But you know the proof of this one, that as a son with his father, so he has served with me in the good news.
This one I hope to send to you soon, when I see how ‹things result› with me.
And I trust in my Master that I also will soon come to you.
But now a matter has pressed me to send to you Epaphroditus, the brother who is a helper and laborer with me, but your apostle and minister to my need.
Because he was longing to see you all, and was distressed that he knew you had heard that he was sick.
For he was also sick nearly to death, but Elohim had mercy on him; and not only on him, but also on me, that I might not have sorrow upon sorrow.
Therefore I have sent him promptly to you, so that when you see him again you may rejoice, and I may have a little relief.
Therefore receive him in Master YHWH with all joy, and hold in honor those who are such.
For because of the work of the Mashiyach he came near to death, and disregarded his life, that he might fill what you were lacking in the service toward me.
Finally, my brothers, rejoice in our Master. To write these ‹things› again and again to you is not wearisome to me, because they caution you.
Watch out for dogs; watch out for evil workers; watch out for the cutting of the flesh.
For we are the ‹real› circumcision, who serve Elohim in spirit, and boast in Y'shua the Mashiyach, and put no trust on the flesh.
Though I also had confidence on the flesh. For if anyone thinks his confidence is on the flesh, I more than he.
Circumcised on the eighth day; from the stock of Yisrael; from the tribe of Benyamin; a Hebrew, son of Hebrews; as to the law, a Pharisee;
as to zeal, a persecutor of the assembly; and as to the righteousness of the law, I was without fault.
But these things that were a gain to me, I have counted as a loss because of the Mashiyach.

And I also count them all a loss because of the greatness of the knowledge of Y'shua the Mashiyach my Master, for whose sake I have lost everything and have counted ‹them› as dung, that I may gain the Mashiyach,
and be found in him, not having a righteousness of my own that is from the law, but that which is from the faith of the Mashiyach, which is the righteousness from Elohim;
that I may know Y'shua and the power of his resurrection, and share in his sufferings, and be conformed to his death,
if somehow I may attain to the resurrection from the dead.
Not that I have already taken ‹the prize›, or am already complete; but I run, that I may take hold of that for which Y'shua the Mashiyach took hold of me.
My brothers, I do not reckon myself as having attained ‹it›. But one ‹thing› I know, that I forget the things behind me, and I stretch forward to the things before me;
and I run toward the goal, that I may obtain the ‹prize› of victory of the calling of Elohim from above in Y'shua the Mashiyach.
Therefore let those who are perfect think these things; and if you think anything differently, Elohim will also reveal this to you.
Nevertheless, to what we have reached, let us walk in one path and with one consent.
Be like me, my brothers; and keep watching those who walk in this way, as you have the pattern you saw in us.
For there are many who walk otherwise; of whom I have often told you, and now I tell you with weeping, that they are enemies of the cross of the Mashiyach;
whose end is destruction; those whose Elohim is their belly, and their glory is their shame; these whose thoughts are on the earth.
But our citizenship is in heaven, and from there we look for the Life-Giver, our Master Y'shua the Mashiyach,
who will change the body of our lowliness so that it may be in the likeness of the body of his glory, according to his great power by which he subjects all things to himself.
Therefore, my beloved and dear brothers, my joy and my crown—so stand in our Master, my beloved!
I ask of Euodia and of Syntyche that they be of one mind in our Master.
I also ask of you, my true yoke-fellow, that you help them who labored with me in the gospel, together with Clement and with the rest of my helpers, whose names are written in the book of life.
Rejoice in our Master at all times; and again I say, Rejoice.
Let your humility be known to everyone. Our Master is near.
Be anxious for nothing; but at all times, by prayer and by supplication and by thanksgiving, let your requests be made known before Elohim.
And the peace of Elohim, that which is greater than all knowledge, will keep your hearts and your minds in Y'shua the Mashiyach.

So then, my brothers, whatever things are true, and whatever things are modest, and whatever things are right, and whatever things are pure, and whatever things are lovely, and whatever things are praiseworthy, and whatever deeds of glory and of commendation, these think on.
These things that you learned and received and heard and saw in me, these practice, and the Elohim of peace will be with you.
But I rejoiced greatly in our Master that you have ‹again› begun to care for me, just as you also were caring, but you were not able.
Yet I am not saying this because I lack; for I have learned that whatever I have is enough for me.
I know how to be brought low, and I also know how to abound; in everything and in all things I am trained, both in being full and in hunger, in abundance and in lack.
I am able ‹to do› everything in the Mashiyach who strengthens me.
Yet you have done well in that you shared in my hardship.
And you also know, Philippians, that in the beginning of the good news, when I left Macedonia, not one of the assemblies shared with me in the account of receiving and giving, except you only;
that even to Thessalonica, once and twice, you sent ‹what› I needed.
Not that I seek a gift, but I seek that fruit may increase for you.
I have received everything and I abound and am full; and I accepted all that you sent me by Epaphroditus, a sweet fragrance and an acceptable sacrifice that pleases Elohim.
And my Elohim will fill all your need according to his riches in the glory of Y'shua the Mashiyach.
And to Elohim our Father be glory and honor forever and ever. Amen.
Greet all the holy ones who are in Y'shua the Mashiyach. The brothers who are with me greet you.

The grace of our Master Y'shua the Mashiyach be with you all. Amen.
Paulos, an apostle of Y'shua the Mashiyach by the will of Elohim, and Timotheos a brother,
to those who are at Qolosos, holy brothers and believers in Y'shua the Mashiyach: peace be with you, and grace from Elohim our Father.
We give thanks to Elohim, the Father of our Master Y'shua the Mashiyach, at all times, and we pray for you;
since we heard of your faith in Y'shua the Mashiyach and of your love toward all the holy ones;
because of the hope that is laid up for you in heaven, of which you heard before in the word of truth of the good news;
which was proclaimed to you, as also to all the world, and is growing and yielding fruit, as it also does among you from the day you heard and came to know the grace of Elohim in truth;
as you learned from Epaphras our beloved fellow-servant, who is for you a faithful minister of the Mashiyach;
and he has made known to us your love in the Ruach.

Because of this we also, from the day we heard ‹of it›, have not ceased to pray for you and to ask that you may be filled with the knowledge of the will of Elohim in all wisdom and in all understanding of the Ruach;
that you may walk as is right and may please Elohim in all good works, and may yield fruit and grow in the knowledge of Elohim;
and may be strengthened with all strength according to the greatness of his glory, in all patience and long-suffering and with joy;
give thanks to Elohim the Father, who has made us fit for a portion of the inheritance of the holy ones in light;
and he has rescued us from the dominion of darkness and brought us into the kingdom of his beloved Son;
in whom we have redemption and forgiveness of sins:
who is the likeness of the invisible Elohim, and the first-born of all creation:

and by him everything was created that is in heaven and on earth, all that is seen and all that is unseen, whether thrones or dominions or principalities or authorities; everything was by his hand and by him was created:
and he is before all, and everything stands by him.
And he is the head of the body of the assembly, who is the head and first-born from among the dead, that he might be first in everything.

and by him to reconcile all things to himself; and through him he has made peace by the blood of his cross, through his hands, whether those on earth or those in heaven.
And also to you, who were formerly aliens and enemies in your minds because of your evil deeds, he has now given you peace
by the body of his flesh and by his death, that he might establish you before him holy, without blemish, and without blame;

if you continue in your faith, your foundation being firm, and you are not moved from the hope of the gospel that you heard, which is proclaimed in all creation under heaven, of which I Paulos became a minister.
And I rejoice in the sufferings that are for your sake; and in my flesh I fill up what is lacking in the afflictions of the Mashiyach on behalf of his body, which is the church;
of which I became a minister according to the stewardship of Elohim that was given to me among you, to fulfill the word of Elohim,
‹namely,› the mystery that was hidden from the ages and from the generations, but now has been revealed to his holy ones;
to whom Elohim willed to make known what is the riches of the glory of this mystery among the peoples, which is the Mashiyach who is in you, the hope of our glory;
whom we proclaim and teach and make known to every person in all wisdom, that we may present every person perfect in Y'shua the Mashiyach.

But I want you to know what a struggle I have for you, and for those in Laodikeia, and for the rest who have not seen my face in the flesh,

that their hearts may be comforted, and they may be drawn near in love to all the riches of assurance, and to the understanding of the knowledge of the mystery of Elohim the Father and of the Mashiyach,
in whom are hidden all the treasures of wisdom and of knowledge.
But this I say, so that no one may mislead you with the persuasiveness of words.
For though I am separated from you in the flesh, yet I am with you in spirit, and I rejoice that I see your order and the firmness of your faith that is in the Mashiyach.
As therefore you have received Y'shua the Mashiyach our Master, walk in him,
as your roots are strengthened and you are built up in him, and you are established in the faith that you learned, that in it you may abound in thanksgiving.

Beware lest anyone plunder you through philosophy and empty deception, according to the teaching of the children of men and according to the rudiments of the world, and not according to the Mashiyach,
in whom dwells all the fullness of the Divinity bodily.
And in him you also are made complete, for he is the head of all principalities and authorities.

and by his commandments he blotted out the handwriting of our debts which ‹handwriting› was against us, and took ‹it› from the midst and fixed ‹it› to his cross.
And by stripping his body he exposed the principalities and the authorities, and put them to shame openly in his own person.
So let no one judge you in food and in drink, or in the portion of a feast and of a new moon and of Sabbaths,
which are a shadow of the things that are to come; but the body is the Mashiyach.

And let no one desire, by humility of mind, to condemn you so that you subject yourselves to the service of messengers, while he pries into what he has not seen and is vainly puffed up in the mind of his flesh,
and does not hold the head, from which the whole body is framed and constructed with joints and members, and grows with the growth ‹given› of Elohim.
For if you have died with the Mashiyach from the rudiments of the world, why as if you are living in the world are you judged?
Do not touch, and do not taste, and do not handle:
which are for corruption in the using; and they are commandments and teachings of men.
And they appear to have in them a word of wisdom in a show of humility and of the fear of Elohim and of not sparing the body; not in anything of value, but in things that serve the flesh.
If then you have risen with the Mashiyach, seek the place above where the Mashiyach sits at the right hand of Elohim.
Set your mind on the things above, and not on those on the earth.
For you have died, and your life is hidden with the Mashiyach in Elohim.
And when the Mashiyach is revealed, who is our life, then you also will be revealed with him in glory.
Put to death therefore your members that are on the earth: sexual immorality and impurity and passion and evil desire and greed, which is idolatry.
For on account of these ‹things› the wrath of Elohim comes on the children of disobedience.
And in these ‹things› you also walked formerly, when you were living in them.
But now put away from you all these: wrath, anger, malice, reviling, filthy talking.
and do not lie one to another, but put off the old man with all his practices;
and put on the new ‹man› that is renewed in knowledge after the likeness of his Creator;
where there is neither Yehudi nor Aramean, neither circumcision nor uncircumcision, neither Greek nor barbarian, neither slave nor free; but Mashiyach is all, and in all.
Therefore put on, as the elect of Elohim, holy and beloved, compassion and tenderness and kindness and humbleness of mind and gentleness and long-suffering.
And be bearing with one another and forgiving one another, and if anyone has a complaint against his companion, as the Mashiyach forgave you, so also you forgive.
And with all these, ‹join› love, which is the bond of perfection.
And let the peace of the Mashiyach guide your hearts, for to it you were called in one body; and be thankful to the Mashiyach.

And let his word dwell in you richly in all wisdom, and be teaching and admonishing yourselves with psalms and with hymns and with songs of the spirit, and with grace be singing in your hearts to Elohim.
And everything that you do in word and in deed, do in the name of our Master Y'shua the Mashiyach, and be giving thanks through him to Elohim the Father.
Wives, be subject to your husbands, as is right in the Mashiyach.
Husbands, love your wives, and do not be bitter toward them.
Children, obey your parents in everything, for this is pleasing before our Master.
Fathers, do not anger your children, lest they be discouraged.
Servants, obey in everything your bodily masters, not with eye-service like those who please men, but with a simple heart and in the fear of Master YHWH.
And whatever you do, do it from all your soul, as to our Master and not as to men.
And know that from our Master you will receive the recompense of the inheritance, for you serve Master YHWH the Mashiyach.
But the wrongdoer will be repaid according to the wrong he did, and there is no respect of persons.
Masters, do equity and justice toward your servants, and know that you also have a master in heaven.
Be steadfast in prayer, and be watchful in it, and give thanks.
And pray also for us, that Elohim would open to us a door for the word, to speak the mystery of the Mashiyach, for which I am bound,
that I may reveal it and speak it as it is fitting for me.
Walk in wisdom toward those outside, and redeem your opportunity.
And let your word at all times be with grace, seasoned as with salt, and know how you ought to give answer to each person.
And what is ‹occurrent› with me, Tukiqos will make known to you; a beloved brother and a faithful minister and our fellow-servant in Master YHWH.
This one I have sent to you for this very thing, that he may know what is with you and may comfort your hearts;
with Ansimos, a faithful and beloved brother who is from among you. These will make known to you what is ‹occurrent› with us.
Aristarkos, my fellow-captive, greets you; and Marqos, the son of the uncle of Bar-Naba, about whom you were commanded that if he comes to you, you are to receive him;
and Y'shua who is called Yustus. These who are from the circumcision, and they alone have aided me in the kingdom of Elohim, and they have been a comfort to me.
Apapra, who is from among you, a servant of the Mashiyach, greets you, always laboring for you in prayer that you may stand perfect and complete in all the will of Elohim.
For I testify about him that he has much zeal for you and for those in Ladiqiya and those in Irapolis.
Luqa the physician, our beloved, asks for your peace, and Dema.

And when this letter is read among you, cause that it also be read in the assembly of Ladiqiya, and the one written from Ladiqiya, you read.
And say to Arkippos: Take heed to the service that you received in our Master, that you fulfill it.
This greeting is by my own hand, of Paulos. Be mindful of my bonds. Grace be with you. Amen.
Paulos and Silwanos and Timotheos, to the assembly of the Thessalonians that is in Elohim the Father and in our Master Y'shua the Mashiyach: grace with you, and peace.
We give thanks to Elohim at all times for all of you, and we remember you continually in our prayers,
and we call to mind before Elohim the Father the work of your faith, and the labor of your love, and the endurance of your hope that is in our Master Y'shua the Mashiyach.
For we know your election, my brothers, beloved of Elohim.
Because our preaching among you was not in word only, but also in power and in Ruach haKodesh and in true persuasion. You also know how we were among you for your sake.
And you became imitators of us and of our Master, for you received the word in great affliction and with the joy of Ruach haKodesh.
And you became a pattern to all the believers who are in Macedonia and in Achaia.

For from you the word of our Master has sounded forth; ‹and› not only in Macedonia and in Achaia, but in every place your faith in Elohim has been heard, so that we have no need to say anything concerning you.
For they declare what entrance we had to you, and how you turned to Elohim from the worship of idols, to serve the living and true Elohim;
while you wait for his Son from heaven, Y'shua whom he raised from the dead, who delivers us from the wrath that is coming.
And you yourselves know, my brothers, that our entrance among you was not in vain:
but first we suffered and were treated with indignity, as you know, in Pilipos; and then, in a great contest, we spoke with you with boldness of our Elohim the gospel of the Mashiyach.
For our exhortation was not from error, nor from impurity, nor in deceit:
but as we were approved by Elohim to be entrusted with his gospel, so we speak, not as pleasing the sons of men, but Elohim who examines our hearts.
For never have we used flattering speech, as you know; nor a cloak of greed—Elohim is witness.
And we did not seek glory from men, neither from you nor from others, when we could have been weighty as apostles of the Mashiyach.
But we were humble among you, and like a nurse who cherishes her children,
so we also cherish ‹you› and long to give to you not only the good news of Elohim, but also our own soul, because you are beloved to us.
For you remember, brothers, that we labored and toiled, working with our hands by night and by day, so that we would not burden any one of you.
You are witnesses, and Elohim, how we proclaimed to you the good news of Elohim, purely and uprightly, and without blame toward all the believers.
as you know, that one by one of you, as a father his children, we were entreating and speaking into your hearts and testifying to you,
that you would walk as is fitting for Elohim, who called you to his kingdom and his glory.

Therefore we also give thanks continually to Elohim that the word of Elohim which you received from us, you did not receive as the word of men, but as it truly is the word of Elohim, and it is at work in you who believe.

But you, my brothers, became like the assemblies of Elohim that are in Yehuda, those who are in Y'shua the Mashiyach, in that you also suffered thus from the sons of your own people, just as they also from the Yehudaye,
who killed our Master Y'shua the Mashiyach and their own prophets and persecuted us, and they do not please Elohim and are hostile to all the sons of men,
hindering us from speaking with the peoples that they may have life, to fill up their sins at all times. But wrath has come upon them to the end.
But we, brothers, were orphaned from you for a short time in face and not in heart, and more abundantly we were eager to see your faces with much love.
And we desired to come to you, I Paulos once and twice, and Satana hindered me.
For what is our hope and our joy and the crown of our glorying, if not you, before our Master Y'shua at his coming?
For you are our glory and our joy.
And because we could no longer endure, we were willing to be left alone at Athens,
and we sent to you Timotheos our brother and minister of Elohim and our helper in the announcement of the Mashiyach, that he might strengthen you and inquire of you about your faith,
so that no one of you would be shaken by these afflictions. For you know that we are appointed to this.
For even when we were with you, we said to you beforehand that we are about to be afflicted, as you know it happened.
Because of this I also could not endure until I sent to know your faith, lest the tempter tempt you and our labor be in vain.

But now, since Timotheos has come to us from you and has told us good news about your faith and your love, and that you have a good remembrance of us at all times, and you long to see us just as we also ‹long to see› you;
Therefore we are comforted in you, our brothers, in all our distresses and afflictions, because of your faith.
And now we live, if you stand firm in our Master.
For what thanksgiving can we repay to Elohim for you, for all the joy with which we rejoice because of you,
except that before Elohim we pray exceedingly night and day that we may see your faces and may complete what is lacking in your faith?
Now may Elohim our Father and our Master Y'shua the Mashiyach direct our way to you,
and may he increase and make abound your love one toward another and toward everyone, just as we love you;
and establish your hearts blameless in holiness before Elohim our Father at the coming of our Master Y'shua the Mashiyach with all his holy ones.
So then, my brothers, we entreat you and beseech you by our Master Y'shua, that as you received from us how you ought to walk and to please Elohim, you would abound still more.
For you know what commandments we gave you by our Master Y'shua.
For this is the will of Elohim, your holiness, and that you be separated from all fornication;
and that each one of you know how to possess his vessel in holiness and in honor,
and not in the passion of lust, like the rest of the peoples who do not know Elohim;
and that you not transgress and wrong anyone his brother in this matter, because our Master is the avenger of all these, as we also said to you before and testified.
For Elohim did not call you to impurity, but to holiness.
Therefore the one who rejects does not reject a human, but Elohim, who has given his holy Ruach in you.
Now concerning love of the brothers, you do not need me to write to you, for you yourselves are taught by Elohim to love one another.
And you also do so toward all the brothers who are in all Macedonia. But I ask of you, my brothers, that you abound still more,
and that you strive to be quiet and to attend to your own affairs, and work with your own hands, as we commanded you,
so that you walk becomingly toward those outside, and that you depend on no one.
But I want you to know, my brothers, that you should not grieve over those who are asleep, like the rest of people who have no hope.
For if we believe that Y'shua died and rose, so also Elohim will bring with him those who have fallen asleep in Y'shua.
And this we say to you by the word of our Master, that we who remain and are alive at the coming of our Master will not precede those who have fallen asleep.
Because our Master himself will descend from heaven with a command and with the voice of the chief messenger and with the trumpet of Elohim, and the dead who are in the Mashiyach will rise first.
And then we who remain and are alive will be caught up together with them in the clouds to meet our Master in the air, and so we will always be with our Master.
Therefore comfort one another with these words.
But concerning the times and the seasons, my brothers, you do not need that I write to you.
For you know assuredly that the day of our Master so comes as a thief in the night.
When they will say, Peace and quietness, then suddenly destruction will rise upon them, as labor pains upon a pregnant woman, and they will not escape.
But you, my brothers, are not in darkness, that that day should overtake you as a thief.
For you are all children of light and children of day, and you are not children of night and not children of darkness.
So let us not sleep like the rest, but let us be awake and sober.
For those who sleep, sleep in the night; and those who get drunk, get drunk in the night.
