Watch yourselves, that you do not lose what you have worked, but that you may be repaid a full reward.
Everyone who goes beyond and does not remain in the teaching of the Mashiyach, Elohim is not in him. He who remains in his teaching, this one has the Father and the Son.
If anyone comes to you and does not bring this teaching, do not receive him into the house, and do not say to him, Joy to you.
for the one who says to him, Joy to you, is a sharer in his evil deeds.
Though I had many things to write to you, I did not want to with paper and ink, but I hope to come to you and speak mouth to mouth, so that our joy may be complete.
The children of your elect sister salute your peace. Amen.
The elder to Gaius the beloved, whom I love in the truth.
Beloved, in everything I pray for you that you may prosper and be in health, just as your soul prospers.
For I rejoiced greatly that the brothers came and testified about your truth, just as you walk in the truth.
I have no greater joy than this, to hear that my children walk in the truth.
Beloved, you do in faith what you perform toward the brothers, and especially toward those who are strangers,
who have testified about your love before the whole assembly. You do well that you supply them as is fitting to Elohim.
For they went out for the sake of his name, taking nothing from the peoples.
Therefore we ought to receive those like these, so that we may be helpers of the truth.
I wanted to write to the church, but he who loves to be first among them, Diotrephes, does not receive us.

Because of this, if I come, I will bring to mind his works that he does, speaking evil words against us; and not content with these, he does not receive the brothers, and those who receive ‹them› he forbids and throws out of the church.
Beloved, do not imitate what is evil, but what is good. The one who does good is from Elohim; the one who does evil has not seen Elohim.
About Demetrius there is testimony from everyone and from the church and from the truth itself; and we also bear ‹him› witness, and you know that our testimony is true.
I had many things to write to you, but I do not want to write ‹them› to you with ink and pen.
But I hope soon to see you, and we will speak mouth to mouth. Peace be with you. The friends greet you. Greet the friends, each one by name.
Yehuda, a servant of Y'shua the Mashiyach, and brother of Ya'akov, to the called peoples, beloved in Elohim the Father, and kept in Y'shua the Mashiyach:
Mercy and peace and love be multiplied to you.
My beloved, while I take all diligence to write to you about our common life, I have need to write to you, as I exhort you to contend for the faith that was once delivered to the holy ones.

For some men have crept in, those who from the beginning were written beforehand to this condemnation, wicked men who turn the grace of our Elohim into impurity, and deny him who alone is Master Elohim and our Master Y'shua the Mashiyach.
But I want to remind you, though you know all these things, that Elohim, when he once delivered the people from Mitsrayin, the second time destroyed those who did not believe.
And the messengers who did not keep their primacy, but left their own dwelling, he has kept in unknown chains under gloom for the judgment of the great day.

As Sedom and Amora and the cities around them, which in the same likeness as these committed whoredom and went after other flesh, are set under the example of everlasting fire while condemned to judgment.
In the same likeness also these who dream defile the flesh, but despise lordship and blaspheme glory.

But Mikael the chief of the messengers, who when contending with the Accuser was speaking about the body of Moshe, did not dare to bring against him a judgment of blasphemy, but said, Master YHWH will rebuke you.
But these blaspheme in the things they do not know; and in the things they understand naturally like mute animals, in those they corrupt themselves.
Woe to them, for they have gone in the way of Qayin, and after the error of Balaam they have rushed for reward, and in the rebellion of Qorach they have perished.

These are they who in their feastings riot while staining themselves, feeding themselves without fear; clouds without rain driven by the wind; trees whose fruit has failed, that are without fruit, that have died twice and been pulled up from their roots.
wild waves of the sea that by their foam show their shame; wandering stars for whom the gloom of darkness is kept forever.
And Enoch also prophesied about these, who is the seventh from Adam, when he said: Look, Master YHWH comes with myriads of his holy ones,
to do judgment on all and to convict every soul because of all the deeds they did wickedly and because of all the hard words that wicked sinners spoke.
These are the ones who murmur and complain about everything while they walk according to their own desires, and their mouth speaks swollen things, and they praise faces for the sake of gain.
But you, my beloved, remember the words that were spoken beforehand by the apostles of our Master Y'shua the Mashiyach,
that they were saying to you that in the last time there will be mockers who go after their own desires in wickedness.
These are they who separate ‹themselves›, sensual persons, who have no Ruach.
But you, my beloved, build yourselves up from the beginning in your holy faith, while praying in the Ruach haKodesh.
And keep yourselves in the love of Elohim, while we wait for the mercy of our Master Y'shua the Mashiyach, for our life that is eternal.
And snatch some of them from the fire.
But when they repent, have compassion on them with fear, hating even the tunic that is defiled by the flesh.
And to him who is able to keep us without stumbling and without spot, and to establish ‹us› without blemish,

to the only Elohim, our Life-Giver, by means of Y'shua the Mashiyach our Master, before his glory, with joy, ‹namely,› to him be glory and dominion and honor and greatness, both now and in all ages. Amen.
The revelation of Y'shua the Mashiyach, which Elohim gave him, to show his servants what must happen soon: and he made ‹it› known by sending through his messenger to his servant Yochanan;
who bore witness to the word of Elohim, and to the testimony of Y'shua the Mashiyach, to all that he saw.
Blessed is the one who reads, and those who hear the words of this prophecy, and keep what is written in it; for the time is near.
Yochanan to the seven assemblies that are in Asia: grace to you and peace from him who is, and who was, and who is coming, and from the seven spirits that are before his throne;
and from Y'shua the Mashiyach, the faithful witness, the firstborn of the dead, and the head of the kings of the earth; who loves us and has released us from our sins by his blood;
and has made us a priestly kingdom to Elohim and his Father: to him be glory and dominion forever and ever. Amen.
He comes with the clouds, and every eye will see him, also those who pierced him, and all the tribes of the earth will mourn over him. Yes and amen.
I am Alap and Tau, says Master YHWH Elohim, he who is and who was and who is coming, he who holds all.

I Yochanan, your brother and partaker with you in the affliction and in the patience that are in Y'shua, was on the island that is called Patmos because of the word of Elohim and because of the testimony of Y'shua the Mashiyach.
And I was in the Ruach on the first day of the week, and I heard behind me a great voice like a shofar
that said, What you see, write in a book and send to the seven assemblies, to Ephesos and to Smyrna and to Pergamos and to Thyatira and to Sardis and to Philadelphia and to Laodicea.
And I turned to know the voice that was speaking with me, and when I turned I saw seven lampstands of gold.
and in the midst of the lampstands one like the likeness of a son of man, clothed with an ephod and bound at his breasts with a girdle of gold.
But his head and his hair were white like wool and like snow, and his eyes like a flame of fire.
and his feet like the likeness of brass of Lebanon heated in a furnace, and his voice like the sound of many waters.
And he has in his right hand seven stars, and from his mouth goes out a sharp sword, and his appearance is like the sun shining in its strength.
And when I saw him I fell at his feet like a dead man, and he laid his right hand on me, saying, Do not fear; I am the First and the Last,
and the Living One; I was dead, and see, I am alive forever and ever. Amen. And I have the keys of death and of Sheol.
Therefore write what you have seen, and the things that are, and the things that are to be after these.

The mystery of the seven stars that you saw on my right hand, and the seven lampstands of gold. The seven stars are the messengers of the seven churches, and the seven lampstands of gold that you saw are the seven churches.
To the messenger of the church in Ephesos write: Thus says he who holds the seven stars in his hand, he who walks among the lampstands of gold;

I know your works, and your toil, and your patience, and ‹that› you cannot endure the wicked; and you have tested those who say of themselves that they are apostles, and they are not; and you have found them liars.
And you have patience, and you have borne for the sake of my name, and have not grown weary.
But I have ‹a charge› against you, that you have left your first love.
Remember from where you have fallen, and do the first works; and if not, I am coming upon you and will move your lampstand, unless you repent.
But this you have, that you hate the deeds of the Nicolaitans, which I also ‹hate›.
He who has an ear, let him hear what the Ruach speaks to the churches. And to him who conquers I will give to eat from the tree of life which is in the paradise of Elohim.
And to the messenger of the church of Zmurna write: Thus says the First and the Last, he who was dead and lives.
I know your affliction and your poverty, but you are rich; and the blasphemy from those who say they are Yehudaye, and they are not, but are a congregation of Satana.

Do not fear any of the things you are about to suffer. Look, the Accuser is about to throw some of you into prison so that you may be tested, and there will be affliction for you ten days. Be faithful until death, and I will give you the crown of life.
He who has an ear, let him hear what the Ruach speaks to the churches. He who conquers will not be harmed by the second death.
And to the messenger of the church in Pergama write: Thus says he who has the sharp sword with two edges;
I know where you dwell, the place of the throne of Satana, and you hold my name and have not denied my faith, and in the days when my faithful witness was contested, who was killed among you.

But I have a little against you, that you have there those who hold the teaching of Balaam, who taught Balak to cast a stumbling-block before the sons of Yisrael, to eat the sacrifices of idols and to commit whoredom.
So also you have those who hold the teaching of the Nicolaitans likewise.
Repent therefore; and if not, I am coming upon you quickly and will war with them with the sword of my mouth.

He who has an ear, let him hear what the Ruach speaks to the assemblies. To him who conquers I will give of the hidden manna, and I will give him a white stone, and on the stone a new name written that no one knows except he who receives it.
And to the messenger of the assembly in Thyatira write: Thus says the Son of Elohim, who has eyes like a flame of fire and his feet like fine brass.
I know your works and your love and your faith and your service and your patience, and your latter works are more than the former.

But I have ‹a charge› against you, because you leave alone your woman Iyzabel, she who says of herself that she is a prophetess, and teaches and leads my servants astray to whoredom and to eating the sacrifices of idols.
And I gave her time for repentance, and she is not willing to repent of her whoredom.
I am casting her on a bed, and those who commit adultery with her into great distress, unless they repent of their works.
And her children I will kill with death, and all the churches will know that I am he who searches the kidneys and the heart, and I will give to each of you according to your works.
I say to you, to the rest who are in Thyatira, all those who do not have this teaching, those who have not known the deep things of Satana, as they say: I lay no other burden on you.
But what you have, hold until I come.
And to the one who conquers and keeps my works, I will give him authority over the nations,
to rule them with a rod of iron, and like vessels of a potter you will shatter them. For so I also have received from my Father.
And I will give him the morning star.
Whoever has an ear, let him hear what the Ruach says to the churches.

And to the messenger of the church in Sardis, write: Thus says he who has the seven spirits of Elohim and the seven stars: I know your works, and the name that you have, and that you live, and that you are dead.
Be awake, and strengthen what remains that was about to die; for I have not found your works complete before Elohim.
Remember how you heard and received; keep ‹those precepts›, and turn back. And if you will not wake up, I will come upon you like a thief, and you will not know what hour I come upon you.
But I have a few names in Sardis who have not defiled their garments; and they walk before me in white, and they are worthy.
He who overcomes will thus be clothed in white garments; and I will not blot out his name from the book of life; and I will confess his name before my Father and before his messengers.
He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches.

And to the messenger of the church of Philadelphia write: Thus says the Holy One, the True One, he who has the key of Dawid, who opens and there is none who shuts, and shuts and there is none who opens.
I know your works. And look, I have given before you an open door that no one is able to shut, because you have little strength, and you have kept my word, and have not denied my name.

And look, I am giving from the synagogue of Satana, from those who say of themselves that they are Yehudaye and are not, but are lying. Look, I will make them come and bow down before your feet, and know that I have loved you.
Because you have kept the word of my patience, I also will keep you from the trial that is about to come on all the inhabited world, to try those who dwell on the earth.
I am coming quickly. Hold fast what you have, so that no one takes your crown.

And the one who overcomes, I will make a pillar in the temple of my Elohim, and he will not go out again. And I will write on him the name of my Elohim, and the name of the new city Urishlim that comes down from my Elohim, and my new name.
And he who has an ear, let him hear what the Ruach is saying to the assemblies.
And to the messenger of the assembly of the Laodiceans, write: Thus says the Amen, the faithful and true witness, and the beginning of the creation of Elohim:
I know your works, that you are neither cold nor hot. It would be fitting that you were either cold or hot.
And you are lukewarm, and neither cold nor hot; I am about to vomit you from my mouth.
Because you say, I am rich and have grown rich and have need of nothing, and you do not know that you are the weak and miserable and poor and naked one.

I counsel you to buy from me gold refined by fire, that you may become rich, and white garments to put on, and that the shame of your nakedness may not be revealed, and eye-salve to anoint your eyes, that you may see.
I rebuke and chasten those I love. Be zealous therefore, and repent.
I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, I will come in and dine with him, and he with me.
And to the one who conquers I will give to sit with me on my throne, just as I conquered and sat with my Father on his throne.
Whoever has an ear, let him hear what the Ruach says to the assemblies.

After these things I looked, and a door ‹was› open in heaven. And the voice that I heard was like a trumpet speaking with me, saying, Come up here, and I will show you what is given to be after these things.
At once I was in the spirit, and a throne was set in heaven, and on the throne ‹one› was sitting.
And the one sitting was like the appearance of the vision of a jasper stone and of sardius, and a rainbow of cloud around the throne like the appearance of the vision of emerald.
And around the throne were twenty-four thrones, and on the thrones twenty-four elders sitting, clothed in white garments, and on their heads crowns of gold.
And from the throne go out thunders and lightnings and voices, and seven lamps of fire burning before the throne, which are the seven spirits of Elohim.
And before the throne a sea of glass like the likeness of ice, and in the middle of the throne and around the throne four living ones full of eyes from before them and from behind them.

The first living creature is like a lion, and the second living creature is like a calf, and the third living creature has a face like a human, and the fourth living creature is like an eagle that flies.

And the four living creatures, each one of them, stands and has six wings from its claws and upward all around, and from within they are full of eyes, and they have no rest day and night to say: Holy, holy, holy, Master YHWH Elohim, Holder of all, he who is and was and is coming.
And when the four living creatures give glory and honor and thanksgiving to him who sits on the throne and to him who lives forever and ever, amen,
the twenty-four elders fall down before him who sits on the throne and worship him who lives forever and ever, amen, and cast their crowns before the throne while saying,
You are worthy, our Master and our Elohim, to receive glory and honor and power, because you created all, and by your will they were and were created.
And I saw at the right hand of him who sits on the throne a book written inside and outside and sealed with seven seals.
And I saw another strong messenger who proclaims with a loud voice, Who is worthy to open the book and to loose its seals?
And no one in heaven or on the earth or under the earth was able to open the book and to loose its seals and to look at it.
And I wept much because no one was found who was worthy to open the book and to loose its seals.
And one of the elders said to me, Do not weep. Look, the lion from the tribe of Yehuda, the root of Dawid, has conquered; he will open the book and its seals.

And I saw in the midst of the throne and of the four living creatures and of the elders a lamb standing as if slain, and it has seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven Spirits of Elohim that are sent into all the earth.
And he came and took the book from the hand of him who sits on the throne.

And when he took the book, the four Animals and the twenty-four Elders fell down before the Lamb, each one of them having a harp and bowls of gold full of incense, which are the prayers of the holy ones.
They sing a new song and say, You are worthy to take the book and to open its seals, because you were slain and you bought us for Elohim by your blood from every tribe and people and nation;
and you made them a kingdom and priests and kings to our Elohim, and they will reign on the earth.
And I saw and I heard as it were the voice of many messengers around the throne and the Animals and the Elders, and their number was myriads of myriads and thousands of thousands,
and they say with a loud voice, Worthy is the Lamb that was slain to receive power and riches and wisdom and strength and honor and glory and blessing.

and every created thing that is in heaven and on earth and under the earth and in the sea, ‹and› all that are in them. And I heard them saying to the one who sits on the throne and to the Lamb: Blessing and honor and glory and dominion forever and ever.
And the four living creatures say Amen. And the elders fell down and worshiped.
And I saw when the Lamb opened one of the seven seals, and I heard one of the four living ones saying like a voice of thunder, Come and see.
And I heard and I saw, and look, a white horse, and he who sat on it had a bow, and a crown was given to him, and he went out conquering and he conquered and that he might conquer.
And when he opened the second seal, I heard the second living one saying, Come.
And a red horse went out, and to him who sat on it it was given to take peace from the earth, that they should kill one another, and a great sword was given to him.
And when the third seal was opened, I heard the third living one saying, Come. And look, a black horse, and he who sat on it had a balance in his hand.
And I heard a voice from among the living ones saying, A measure of wheat for a denarius, and three measures of barley for a denarius, and do not harm the wine and the oil.
And when he opened the fourth seal, I heard the voice of the living creature that says, Come.

And I saw a pale horse, and the name of him who sits on it is Death, and Sheol follows him. And authority was given to him over a fourth of the earth, to kill with the sword and with famine and with death and with the living creatures of the earth.
And when he opened the fifth seal, I saw under the altar the souls of those who were killed because of the word of Elohim and because of the testimony of Y'shua that was theirs.
And they cried out with a loud voice and say, Until when, Master YHWH, holy and true, do you not judge and avenge our blood from those who dwell on the earth?

And a white robe was given to each one of them, and it was said that they should rest yet a little while, until their fellow-servants and their brothers are also completed, those who are about to be killed as they also were.
And I saw when he opened the sixth seal, and there was a great earthquake, and the sun became black like sackcloth of hair, and the whole moon became like blood.
And the stars of heaven fell on the earth, as a fig tree casts its unripe figs when it is shaken by a strong wind.
And the heaven was separated, and like a book they were rolled up, and every mountain and every island were moved from their places.
And the kings of the earth and the nobles and the chiefs of thousands and the rich and the mighty and every servant and freeborn hid themselves in the caves and in the rocks of the mountains.
And they say to the mountains and the rocks, Fall on us and hide us from before the face of the Lamb.
Because the great day of their wrath has come, and who is able to stand?
And after this I saw four messengers standing on the four corners of the earth, and they held the four winds so that a wind would not blow on the earth nor on the sea nor on any tree.

And I saw another messenger who came up from the rising of the sun, and he had the seal of the living Elohim, and he cried out with a loud voice to those four messengers to whom it was given to harm the earth and the sea,
and he said, Do not harm the earth nor the sea nor even the trees until we seal the servants of Elohim between their eyes.
And I heard the number of the sealed, a hundred and forty-four thousand from every tribe of Yisrael.
From the tribe of Yehuda twelve thousand, from the tribe of Rubil twelve thousand, from the tribe of Gad twelve thousand,
from the tribe of Ashir twelve thousand, from the tribe of Naphtali twelve thousand, from the tribe of Menashe twelve thousand,
from the tribe of Shimon, twelve thousand; from the tribe of Issachar, twelve thousand; from the tribe of Levi, twelve thousand
from the tribe of Zebulun, twelve thousand; from the tribe of Yosip, twelve thousand; from the tribe of Benyamin, twelve thousand, sealed.

After these things I saw a great crowd, one that no one was able to number, from every people and tribe and nation and tongue, standing before the throne and before the Lamb, clothed in white robes, and palm branches in their hands;
and they cry out with a loud voice and say, Deliverance to our Elohim and to him who sits on the throne and to the Lamb.
And all the messengers were standing around the throne and the elders and the four living creatures, and they fell on their faces before the throne
saying, Amen. Glory and blessing and wisdom and thanksgiving and honor and power and strength ‹be› to our Elohim forever and ever. Amen.
And one of the elders answered and said to me, These who are clothed in white robes, who are they, and from where did they come?
And I said to him, My Master, you know. And he said to me, These are they who came from the great affliction, and they washed their robes and made them white in the blood of the Lamb.
Because of this they are before the throne of Elohim, and they serve him day and night in his temple, and he who sits on the throne will shelter them.
They will not hunger, and they will not thirst, and the sun will not fall on them, nor any heat.
Because the Lamb who is in the midst of the throne will feed them, and will lead them to life and to springs of waters, and will wipe every tear from their eyes.
And when he opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven for about half an hour.
And I saw the seven messengers who stood before Elohim, and to them were given seven trumpets.
And another messenger came and stood at the altar, and he had a censer of gold, and much incense was given to him to give with the prayers of all the holy ones upon the altar before the throne.
And the smoke of the incense with the prayers of the holy ones went up from the hand of the messenger before Elohim.
And the messenger took the censer and filled it from the fire on the altar and threw it on the earth, and there were thunders and voices and lightnings and an earthquake.
And the seven messengers who had the seven trumpets prepared themselves to sound.

And the first sounded, and there was hail and fire mixed with water, and they were thrown on the earth, and a third of the earth burned, and a third of the trees burned, and all the grass of the earth burned.
And the second sounded, and it was like a great mountain burning that fell into the sea, and a third of the sea became blood.
And a third of every creature in the sea that has life in it died, and a third of the ships were destroyed.
And the third sounded, and a great star burning like a torch fell from heaven, and it fell on a third of the rivers and on the springs of water.
And the name of the star is called Wormwood, and a third of the waters became like wormwood, and many of the sons of men died because the waters were made bitter.

And the fourth sounded, and a third of the sun was swallowed, and a third of the moon, and a third of the stars, and a third of them were darkened, and the day did not show a third of it, and the night likewise.
And I heard one eagle that flies in heaven saying, Woe, woe, woe to the inhabitants of the earth from the sound of the trumpets of the three messengers who are about to sound.
And the fifth messenger sounded, and I saw a star that fell from heaven on the earth, and the key of the pit of the abyss was given to him.
And smoke went up from the pit like the smoke of a great furnace that is blazing, and the sun and the air were darkened by the smoke of the pit.
And from the smoke locusts came out on the earth, and authority was given to them like that which the scorpions of the earth have.
And it was said to them that they should not harm the grass of the earth nor any green thing nor any tree, but ‹only› the people who do not have the seal of Elohim between their eyes.
And it was given to them that they should not kill them, but should torment them five months, and their torment is like the torment of a scorpion when it falls on a person.
And in those days people will seek death and will not find it, and they will long to die, and death will flee from them.

And the appearance of the locusts ‹was this›: they were like the appearance of horses prepared for battle; and on their heads was like a crown resembling gold; and their faces were like the faces of men.
And they had hair like the hair of women; and their teeth were like those of lions.
And they had breastplates like breastplates of iron; and the sound of their wings was like the sound of the chariots of many horses running to battle.
And they had tails like the appearance of scorpions, and stings in their tails; and their authority was to hurt the children of men five months.
And they had a king over them, the messenger of the abyss, whose name in Hebrew is Abaddon, and in Aramaic he has the name Shara.
One woe has gone; look, two more woes are still coming.
After these the sixth messenger sounded, and I heard one voice from the four horns of the golden altar that is before Elohim,
that said to the sixth messenger who has the trumpet: Loose the four messengers that are bound at the great river Prath.
And the four messengers were loosed, who are prepared for the hour and for the day and for the month and for the year, to kill a third of the sons of men.
And the number of the armies of the horsemen was two myriads of myriads: I heard their number.

And thus I saw the horses in the vision, and those who sat on them ‹I saw› that they had breastplates of fire and of jacinth and of sulphur. And the heads of their horses were like the heads of lions, and from their mouths went out fire and smoke and sulphur.
And by these three plagues a third of the sons of men were killed, ‹namely,› by the fire and by the smoke and by the sulphur that went out from their mouths.
Because the power of the horses is in their mouths and also in their tails.

And the rest of the sons of men who were not killed by these plagues did not repent from the works of their hands, so that they would not worship demons and idols of gold and of silver and of brass and of wood and of stone, which cannot see and cannot hear or walk.
And they did not repent from their murders and from their sorceries and from their whoredom.
And I saw another messenger who came down from heaven, wrapped in a cloud, and the bow of heaven was on his head, and his appearance was like the sun, and his feet like pillars of fire.
And he had in his hand an open little book, and he set his right foot on the sea, and his left on the land.
And he cried out with a loud voice like a lion that roars, and when he cried out, the seven thunders spoke with their voices.
And when the seven thunders spoke, I was ready to write, and I heard a voice from heaven that said, Seal up what the seven thunders spoke, and do not write it.
And the messenger whom I saw standing on the sea and on the dry land raised his hand to heaven,
and swore by him who lives forever and ever, who created the heaven and what is in it, and the earth and what is in it, that time will no longer be.
but in the days of the seventh messenger, when he is about to cry out, and the mystery of Elohim is completed, that which he announced to his servants the prophets.
And I heard a voice from heaven again that was speaking with me and said, Go, take the little book that is in the hand of the messenger who stands on the earth and on the sea.
And I went to the messenger, saying to him to give me the little book. And he said to me, Take and eat it, and it will make your belly bitter, but in your mouth it will be like honey.
And I took the little book from the hand of the messenger and ate it, and it was in my mouth like sweet honey, and when I had eaten it, my belly was bitter.
And he said to me, It is given to you again a time to prophesy over peoples and nations and tongues and many kings.
And a reed was given to me like a rod; and the messenger was standing and said, Rise and measure the temple of Elohim and the altar and those who worship in it.
And the court that is outside the temple, cast out, and do not measure it, because it is given to the peoples; and they will trample the holy city forty-two months.
And I will give to my two witnesses to prophesy a thousand two hundred sixty days, clothed in sackcloth.
These are the two olive trees and the two lampstands that stand before the master of all the earth.
And whoever wants to harm them, fire goes out from their mouth and consumes their enemies; and whoever wants to harm them, thus it is given to them to be killed.

And these have authority to shut the sky so that rain does not fall in the days of their prophecy, and they have authority to turn the waters into blood and to strike the earth with every plague as often as they want.
And when they have completed their testimony, the beast that comes up from the sea will make war with them and will conquer them and will kill them.
And their corpses ‹will be› on the street of the great city, which is called spiritually Sodom and Mitsrayin, where their Master was crucified.
And from the nations and tribes and tongues and peoples they look on their corpses three days and a half, and they will not allow their corpses to be placed in a grave.
And those who dwell on the earth will rejoice over them and will make merry and will send gifts to one another, because those two prophets tormented those who dwell on the earth.
And after three days and a half a living spirit from Elohim entered into them and they stood on their feet, and the spirit of life fell on them, and great fear was on those who saw them.
And they heard a great voice from heaven that said to them, Come up here. And they went up to heaven in a cloud, and their enemies watched them.

And in that hour there was a great earthquake, and a tenth of the city fell, and there were killed in the earthquake seven thousand names of men, and the rest were in fear and gave praise to Elohim who is in heaven.
The second woe has passed, and the third woe comes at once.

And the seventh messenger cried out, and there were great voices in heaven saying, The kingdom of the world has become ‹the kingdom› of our Elohim and of his Mashiyach, and he will reign forever and ever.
And the twenty-four elders who sit before Elohim on their thrones fell on their faces and worshipped Elohim,
saying, We give thanks to you, Master YHWH Elohim, Holder of all, who is and who was, because you have taken your great power and have reigned.

And the nations were angry, and your anger has come, and the time of the dead that they should be judged, and that you should give the reward to your servants the prophets and to the holy ones and to those who fear your name, the small with the great, and that you should destroy those who destroyed the earth.
And the temple in heaven was opened, and the ark of his covenant was seen in his temple, and there were lightnings and thunders and voices and an earthquake and great hail.
And a great sign was seen in heaven: a woman clothed with the sun, and the moon under her feet, and a crown of twelve stars on her head.
And she was with child, and she cried out and was in labor, and was also tormented to give birth.
And another sign was seen in heaven, and a great fiery dragon that has seven heads and ten horns, and on his heads seven diadems.

And his tail dragged a third of the stars of heaven and threw them on the earth. And the dragon was standing before the woman who was about to give birth, so that when she gave birth he might devour her son.
And she gave birth to a male son, who is about to shepherd all the peoples with a rod of iron. And her son was snatched away to Elohim and to his throne.
And the woman fled to the wilderness, where she had a place prepared for her by Elohim, that they might nourish her there a thousand two hundred sixty days.
And there was war in heaven: Mikha'el and his messengers were fighting with the dragon, and the dragon and his messengers fought,
and they were not able, and no place was found for them in heaven.
And the great dragon was cast down, that ancient serpent who is called the Accuser and Satana, who led the whole earth astray; he was cast upon the earth, and his messengers were cast down with him.

And I heard a great voice from heaven that said: Now deliverance has come, and power and the kingdom of our Elohim, because the Accuser of our brothers has been cast down, who was accusing them night and day before our Elohim.
And they overcame him by the blood of the Lamb and by the word of their testimony, and they did not love their life even to death.
Because of this, heavens, rejoice, and you who dwell in them. Woe to the earth and to the sea, for the Accuser has come down to them with great wrath, knowing that he has little time.
And when the dragon saw that he was thrown upon the earth, he persecuted the woman who gave birth to the male.
And the woman was given the two wings of the great eagle, that she might fly to the wilderness to her place, to be nourished there a time and times and half a time, from the face of the serpent.
And the serpent threw from his mouth water like a river after the woman, that he might make her be carried away by the water.
And the earth helped the woman, and the earth opened its mouth and swallowed the river that the dragon threw from his mouth.
And the dragon was angry at the woman, and he went to make war with the rest of her seed, those who keep the commandments of Elohim and have the testimony of Y'shua.
And I stood on the sand of the sea, and I saw a beast rising from the sea that has ten horns and seven heads, and on its horns ten diadems, and on its heads a name of blasphemy.
And the beast that I saw was like a leopard, and its feet like ‹those› of a bear, and its mouth like that of lions; and the dragon gave it his power and his throne and great authority.
And one of its heads was as if wounded to death, and the wound of its death was healed. And all the earth wondered after the beast.
And they worshipped the dragon who gave authority to the beast, and they worshipped the beast, saying, Who is like this beast, and who is able to make war with it?
And there was given to it a mouth speaking great things and blasphemy, and authority was given it to act forty-two months.
And it opened its mouth to blaspheme before Elohim, to blaspheme his name and his dwelling and those who dwell in heaven.
And it was given to him to wage war with the saints and to overcome them, and authority was given to him over every tribe and people and tongue and nation.
And all who dwell on the earth will worship him, those who are not written in the book of life of the Lamb slain before the foundation of the world.
Whoever has an ear, let him hear.
If ‹any one› leads into captivity, he goes into captivity; and whoever kills with the sword must be killed with the sword: here is the faith and the patience of the saints.
And I saw another beast that came up from the earth, and it had two horns like a lamb, and it was speaking like the dragon.
And it exercises all the authority of the first beast before it, and it makes the earth and those who dwell in it worship the first beast, whose wound of death was healed.
And he does great signs, so that he makes fire come down from heaven upon the earth before the sons of men.

And he leads astray those who dwell on the earth by the signs that were given to him to do before the beast, saying to those who dwell on the earth to make an image to the beast that has the wound of the sword and lived.
And it was given to him to give life to the image of the beast, and to cause that all who will not worship the image of the beast will be killed.
And he causes all of them, small and great, rich and poor, masters and servants, that a mark be given to them on their right hands or on their foreheads,
so that no one may buy or sell, except the one who has on him the mark of the name of the beast or the number of his name.
Here is wisdom. And he who has understanding in him, let him calculate the number of the beast, for it is the number of a man: six hundred and sixty and six.
And I looked, and look, a Lamb stood on the mountain of Tsiyon, and with him a hundred and forty-four thousand who have his name and the name of his Father written on their foreheads.
And I heard a sound from heaven like the sound of many waters and like the sound of great thunder; the sound that I heard was like harpers striking on their harps.

And they sing as a new song before the throne and before the four living creatures and before the elders, and no one was able to learn the song except the hundred and forty-four thousand who were bought from the earth.

These are they who have not defiled themselves with women, for they are virgins. These are they who follow the Lamb wherever he goes. These were bought from among men, first fruits to Elohim and to the Lamb.
And in their mouth no falsehood was found, for they are without blemish.

And I saw another messenger flying in the midst of heaven, and he had with him the everlasting good news to proclaim over those who dwell on the earth and over every people and nation and tribe and tongue.
saying with a loud voice, Fear Elohim and give him glory, because the hour of his judgment has come; and worship him who made the heavens and the earth and the sea and the springs of water.
And another, a second, followed him and said, Fallen, fallen is Babil the great, who from the heat of her whoredom made all the peoples drink.
And another messenger, a third, followed them, saying with a loud voice, Whoever worships the beast and its image and takes its mark between his eyes,

he also will drink from the wine of the wrath of Master YHWH that is mixed without mixture in the cup of his anger, and will be tormented with fire and brimstone before the holy messengers and before the Lamb.
And the smoke of their torment goes up forever and ever, and they have no rest day or night, those who worship the beast and its image, and whoever takes the mark of its name.
Here is the endurance of the holy ones, those who keep the commandments of Elohim and the faith of Y'shua.
And I heard a voice from heaven that said, Write, Blessed are the dead who die in our Master from now on. Yes, says the Ruach, so that they may rest from their labors.
And look, a white cloud, and on the cloud sat one like a son of man, and on his head was a crown of gold, and in his hand a sharp sickle.
And another messenger came out from the temple and cried with a loud voice to the one sitting on the cloud, Send your sickle and reap, because the hour to reap has come.
And the one sitting on the cloud threw his sickle over the earth, and the earth was reaped.
And another messenger came out from the temple that is in heaven, and on him was a sharp sickle.

And another messenger came out from the altar, who has authority over the fire, and he cried with a loud voice to the one who has the sharp sickle, Send your sharp sickle and gather the clusters of the vineyard of the earth, because its grapes have grown ripe.
And the messenger cast his sickle on the earth, and gathered the vintage of the earth, and cast ‹it› into the great winepress of the wrath of Elohim.
And the winepress was trodden outside the city, and blood came out from the winepress up to the bridles of the horses, for a thousand and two hundred stadia.
And I saw another great and marvelous sign in heaven: messengers who have on them the seven last plagues, in which the wrath of Elohim is completed.

And I saw as it were a sea of glass mixed with fire, and those who had conquered from the beast and from its image and from the number of its name standing above the sea of glass, and they have on them the harps of Elohim.

And they sing the song of Moshe the servant of Elohim and the song of the Lamb, and say: Great and marvelous are your works, Master YHWH Elohim who holds all; just and true are your ways, King of the world.
Who will not fear you, Master YHWH, and glorify your name? Because you alone are holy. Because all the peoples will come and worship before you, because you are upright.
And after these I saw, and the temple of the tent of the testimony in heaven was opened.
And the seven messengers went out from the temple, those who have on them the seven plagues, clothed in clean and bright linen and bound on their chests with a belt of gold.
And one of the four living creatures gave to the seven messengers seven bowls full of the wrath of Elohim who lives forever and ever. Amen.
And the temple was filled with smoke from the glory of Elohim and from his power, and no one was able to enter the temple until the seven plagues of the seven messengers were finished.
And I heard a great voice from the temple that said to the seven messengers, Go and pour out the seven bowls of the wrath of Elohim on the earth.
And the first went and poured his bowl on the earth, and there came a bad and painful sore on the people who had the mark of the beast and who worship its image.
And the second messenger poured his bowl into the sea, and the sea became like a dead person, and every living soul in the sea died.
And the third messenger poured his bowl into the rivers and the springs of water, and they became blood.
And I heard the messenger of the waters who said, You are righteous, he who is and who was, and holy, because you have judged these things.
Because they poured out the blood of prophets and of holy ones, and you have given them blood to drink. They are worthy.
And I heard ‹one from› the altar say: Yes, Master YHWH Elohim who holds all, true and righteous are your judgments.
And the fourth messenger poured his bowl on the sun, and it was given to him to scorch the sons of men with fire.
And the sons of men were scorched with a great heat, and they blasphemed the name of Elohim who has authority over these plagues, and they did not repent to give him glory.
And the fifth messenger poured his bowl on the throne of the beast, and its kingdom became darkness, and they were gnawing their tongues from the pain.
And they blasphemed the name of Elohim of heaven from their pains and from their sores, and they did not repent from their deeds.
And the sixth messenger poured his bowl on the great river Prath, and its waters dried up so that the way might be prepared for the kings from the rising of the sun.
And I saw ‹issuing› from the mouth of the dragon, and from the mouth of the beast, and from the mouth of the false prophet, three unclean spirits like frogs:
for they are spirits of demons that work signs, that go out on the kings of the whole world to gather them to the battle of that great day of Elohim who holds all.
I come like a thief. Blessed is he who is awake and keeps his garments, so that he will not walk naked and they see his shame.
And he gathered them to the place that is called in Hebrew Megdo.
And the seventh messenger poured his cup on the air, and a great voice went out from the temple, from before the throne, that said: It is done!
And there were lightnings and thunders, and there was a great earthquake, the like of which has not been since men were on the earth, an earthquake so great like this.
And the great city became three parts, and the city of the nations fell, and Babil the great was remembered before Elohim, to give her the cup of the wine of the heat of his wrath and of his rage.
And every island fled away, and the mountains were not found.
And a great hail like a talent fell from heaven on the sons of men, and the sons of men blasphemed Elohim because of the plague of the hail, for its plague is very great.
And one of the seven messengers who have the seven bowls came and spoke with me, saying, Come after me; I will show you the judgment of the harlot who sits on many waters,
with whom the kings of the earth have committed whoredom, and all the inhabitants of the earth have become drunk from the wine of her whoredom.
And he carried me away to the wilderness in the spirit, and I saw a woman sitting on a scarlet beast that was full of names of blasphemy, that had seven heads and ten horns.
And the woman was clothed in purple and scarlet, gilded with gold and precious stones and pearls, and she had a golden cup in her hand full of the pollution and filth of her whoredom.
And on her forehead was written a mystery: Babil the great, the mother of harlots and of the filth of the earth.
And I saw the woman drunk from the blood of the holy ones and from the blood of the witnesses of Y'shua, and I was amazed with a great amazement when I saw her.
And the messenger said to me, Why do you wonder? I say to you the mystery of the woman, and of the beast that bears her, that has seven heads and ten horns.

The beast that you saw was, and is not, and is about to ascend from the sea and go to destruction: and the dwellers on the earth will wonder, those whose names are not written in the book of life from the foundation of the world, when they see the beast that was, and is not, and has approached.
Here is the mind for him who has wisdom. The seven heads are seven mountains, where the woman sits on them.
And there are seven kings: five have fallen, and one is, the other has not yet come; and when he comes, a little is given to him to remain.
And the beast that was and is not, is itself the eighth, and is from the seven, and goes to destruction.
And the ten horns that you saw are ten kings, those who have not yet received the kingdom, but they take authority as kings for one hour with the beast.
These have one will, and they give their power and authority to the beast.
These will make war with the Lamb, and the Lamb will conquer them, because he is Master of masters and King of kings, and those with him ‹are› called and chosen and faithful.
And he said to me: The waters that you saw, where the harlot sits, are peoples and multitudes and nations and tongues.
And the ten horns that you saw and the beast, these will hate the harlot, and they will make her desolate and naked, and will eat her flesh and burn her with fire.
For Elohim has put in their hearts to do his will, and to do their one will, and to give their kingdom to the beast, until the words of Elohim are fulfilled.
And the woman that you saw is the great city, which has kingdom over the kings of the earth.
After these things I saw another messenger who came down from heaven, who has great authority, and the earth shone from his glory.
And he cried with a great voice, Fallen, fallen is Babil the great, and she has become a dwelling for demons and a prison for every unclean and hateful spirit.

Because from the wine of her fornication she mixed for all the peoples, and the kings of the earth committed fornication with her, and the merchants of the earth grew rich from the power of her luxury.
And I heard another voice from heaven that said, Come out from within her, my people, so that you will not share in her sins, lest you receive from her plagues.
Because her sins have clung in her up to heaven, and Elohim has remembered her injustices.
Repay her as she also repaid, and double for her a double according to her works; in the cup that she mixed, mix for her a double.
As much as she glorified herself and lived in luxury, give her that much torment and mourning, because she says in her heart, I sit a queen, and I am not a widow, and I will not see mourning.
Because of this, in one day her plagues will come upon her: death and mourning and famine, and she will be burned with fire, for strong is Master YHWH who judges her.
And the kings of the earth who committed fornication with her and lived in luxury will weep and mourn over her when they see the smoke of her burning,
standing opposite from fear of her torment, and they will say, Woe, woe, woe, the great city Bavel, the mighty city, because in one hour your judgment has come!
And the merchants of the earth will weep and mourn over her, because no one buys their cargo anymore,

cargo of gold and of silver and of precious stones and of pearls and of fine linen and of purple and of silk and of scarlet, and every fragrant wood, and every vessel of ivory, and every vessel of precious wood, and of bronze and of iron and of marble,
and cinnamon and balsam and myrrh and frankincense and wine and oil and fine flour and wheat and cattle and sheep and horses and chariots and bodies and souls of the sons of men.
And the fruit your soul desired has gone from you, and all that is rich and splendid has gone from you, and you will not see them again.
And the merchants of these who grew rich from her will not find them; they will stand opposite from the fear of her torment, weeping and mourning
and saying, Woe, woe, the great city that is clothed in fine linen and purple and scarlet, gilded with gold and precious stones and pearls,
because in one hour wealth like this is laid waste. And every shipmaster and everyone who goes by ship to a place, and sailors and all who work on the sea, stood from afar
and wept when they saw the smoke of her burning, and said, Who is like this great city?

And they threw dust on their heads and cried out while weeping and mourning and saying, Woe, woe, the great city in which those who have ships in the sea became rich from her preciousness, for in one hour she has been laid waste.
Rejoice over her, heaven and holy ones and apostles and prophets, because Elohim has judged your judgment from her.
And one of the mighty messengers took a great stone like a millstone and threw it into the sea and said, So with violence will Babil the great city be thrown down, and she will not be found again.
And the sound of harp and of flute and of those who make music and of trumpet will not be heard in you again.

And the light of a lamp will not be seen by you again, and the voice of a bridegroom and the voice of a bride will not be heard in you again, because your merchants were the great ones of the earth, because by your sorceries you led all the peoples astray.
And in her was found the blood of prophets and holy ones who were killed on the earth.
And after these things I heard a great voice of a great multitude in heaven saying, Hallelujah! Deliverance and praise and power to our Elohim.
because true and righteous are his judgments, because he has judged the great harlot who corrupted the earth with her whoredom, and has avenged the blood of his servants from her hand.
A second time they said, Hallelujah! And her smoke goes up forever and ever.
And the twenty-four elders and the four living creatures fell down and worshiped our Elohim who sits on the throne, and they say, Amen! Hallelujah!
And a voice from the throne said, Praise our Elohim, all his servants and those who fear his name, all the small with the great.
And I heard a voice like a great multitude and like the voice of many waters and like the voice of mighty thunder saying, Hallelujah! because Master YHWH Elohim, Holder of all, has reigned.
We rejoice and exult, and let us give him glory, because the marriage supper of the Lamb has come, and his wife has prepared herself.
And it was given to her to be clothed in fine linen, clean and bright, for the fine linen is the righteousnesses of the holy ones.
And they said to me, Write: Blessed are those who are called to the supper of the marriage of the Lamb. And he said to me, These words are the true ones of Elohim.

And I fell before his feet and worshiped him. And he said to me, No, I am your fellow-servant, and of these your brothers who have the testimony of Y'shua. Worship Elohim; for the testimony of Y'shua is the spirit of prophecy.
And I saw heaven opened, and a white horse, and the one who sits on it is called Faithful and True, and in righteousness he judges and makes war.
His eyes are like a flame of fire, and on his head many diadems, and he has a name written that no one knows except him.
And he is wrapped in a garment dipped in blood, and his name is called the Word of Elohim.
And the armies of heaven were following him on white horses, and they are clothed in fine linen, white ‹and› pure.
And from their mouth goes out a sharp sword by which they will kill the peoples, and he will shepherd them with a rod of iron, and he treads the winepress of the wrath of Elohim who holds all.
And he has on his garments, on his thigh, a name written: King of kings and Master of masters.
And I saw another messenger standing in the sun, and he cried with a loud voice and said to the birds that fly in the midst of heaven: Assemble to the great supper of Elohim,

that you may eat the flesh of kings and the flesh of captains of thousands and the flesh of the mighty and the flesh of horses and of those who sit on them and the flesh of freemen and of slaves and of small and of great.
And I saw the beast and its armies and the kings of the earth and their warriors, who were gathered to make war with him who sits on the ‹white› horse and with his warriors.

And the beast was captured, and the false prophet with him, who did the signs before it by which he led astray those who received the mark of the beast and those who worshipped its image. And the two of them went down and were thrown into the lake of fire that burns with sulfur.
And the rest were killed by the sword of him who sits on the horse, by that which comes out of his mouth, and all the birds were filled from their flesh.
And I saw another messenger who came down from heaven, who has the key of the abyss and a great chain in his hand.
And he seized the dragon, the ancient serpent, who is the Accuser and Satana, and bound him a thousand years.
And he cast him into the abyss and shut and sealed over him, so that he would not deceive all the peoples again; after these ‹things› it is given to release him a little time.

And I saw thrones, and ‹persons› sat on them, and judgment was given to them, and the souls of those who were beheaded for the testimony of Y'shua and for the word of Elohim, and those who did not worship the beast or its image and did not receive the mark on their forehead or on their hands; and they lived and reigned with the Mashiyach a thousand years.
And this is the first resurrection.

Blessed and holy is the one who has a share in the first resurrection; over these the second death has no authority, but they will be priests of Elohim and of the Mashiyach, and they will reign with him a thousand years.
And when the thousand years are completed, Satana will be released from his imprisonment.
And he will go out to lead astray all the peoples in the four corners of the earth, Gog and Magog, and to gather them for the battle, whose number is like the sand of the sea.
And they went up over the breadth of the earth and surrounded the camp of the holy ones and the beloved city. And fire came down from heaven from Elohim and consumed them.
And the Accuser who led them astray was cast into the lake of fire and sulphur, where the beast and the false prophet are, and they will be tormented day and night for ever and ever.
And I saw a great white throne and the one who sits on it, from whose face earth and heaven fled away, and no place was found for them.

And I saw the dead, great and small, standing before the throne, and the books were opened, and another book was opened which is ‹the book› of life, and the dead were judged from the things written in the books according to their deeds.
And the sea gave the dead that were in it, and death and Sheol gave the dead that were in their hands, and they were judged, each one of them according to their deeds.
And death and Sheol were cast into the lake of fire. This is the second death, ‹namely,› this lake of fire.
And anyone who was not found written in the book of life was cast into the lake of fire.
And I saw a new heaven and a new earth, for the former heaven and the former earth have passed away, and the sea is no more.
And I saw the holy city, new Urishlim, coming down out of heaven from Elohim, prepared like a bride adorned for her husband.

And I heard a great voice from heaven that said: The dwelling of Elohim is with the children of men, and he dwells with them, and they will be his people, and he, Elohim, will be with them and will be Elohim to them.
And he will wipe every tear from their eyes, and death will be no more, nor mourning, nor crying, nor pain will be any more upon her face.
And he who sits on the throne said to me: Look, I make all things new. And he said to me: Write, these words are faithful and true.
And he said to me: I am Alap and I am Tau, the beginning and the completion. To the one who thirsts I will give from the fountain of living water freely.
And he who conquers will inherit these things, and I will be Elohim to him, and he will be a son to me.

But for the timid and the unbelieving and the sinful and the polluted and the murderers and the sorcerers and the fornicators and the servants of idols and all the liars, their portion is in the lake that burns with fire and sulfur, which is the second death.
And one of the seven messengers who have the seven bowls full of the seven last plagues came and spoke with me, saying: Come, I will show you the bride, the wife of the Lamb.
And he carried me away in the spirit to a great and high mountain, and showed me the holy city Urishlim descending out of heaven from Elohim,
and it has the glory of Elohim, and its light is like a precious stone, like jasper stone, like the appearance of crystal.
And it has a great and high wall, and it has twelve gates, and on the gates twelve messengers, and their names are written, which are the names of the twelve tribes of Yisrael.
From the east, three gates; and from the north, three gates; and from the south, three gates; and from the west, three gates.
And the wall of the city has twelve foundations, and on them the twelve names of the apostles of the Lamb.
And the one who was speaking with me had a golden measuring reed on him, to measure the city and its wall.
And the city is laid out four-square, and its length is like its width. And he measured the city with the reed at twelve thousand stadia; its length and its width and its height are equal.
And he measured its wall, a hundred and forty-four cubits by the measure of a man, which is of the messenger.
And the structure of its wall is jasper; and the city is pure gold, like pure glass.
And the foundations of the wall of the city are adorned with precious stones. And the first foundation is jasper, and the second sapphire, and the third chalcedony, and the fourth emerald.
And the fifth sardonyx, and the sixth sardius, and the seventh chrysolite, and the eighth beryl, and the ninth topaz, and the tenth chrysoprase, and the eleventh jacinth, and the twelfth amethyst.
And the twelve gates ‹were› twelve pearls, one to one, and each one of the gates was from one pearl. And the street of the city is pure gold, like glass.
And I saw no temple in it, for Master YHWH Elohim who holds all is its temple.
And the city has no need of the sun or of the moon to shine for it, for the glory of Elohim has enlightened it, and its lamp is the Lamb.
And the peoples walk in its light, and the kings of the earth bring glory to it.
And its gates will not be shut by day, for night will not be there.
And they will bring to it the glory and the honor of the nations.
And nothing unclean will be there, nor anyone who does impurity and falsehood, but only those who are written in the Lamb's book.
And he showed me a river of living water, pure and bright ‹as› crystal, and it went out from the throne of Elohim and of the Lamb.

And in the middle of its broad street, and on the river, from this side and from that, ‹was› the tree of life, that bears twelve ‹sorts of› fruits, and every month it gives its fruits, and its leaves ‹were› for the healing of the nations.
And no curse will be there any more, and the throne of Elohim and of the Lamb will be in it, and his servants will serve him.
And they will see his face, and his name ‹will be› on their foreheads.
And night will not be there, and they will have no need of light or of a lamp or of the light of the sun, because Master YHWH Elohim gives them light, and they will reign forever and ever.
And he said to me, These words ‹are› faithful and true. And Master YHWH Elohim of the spirits of the holy prophets sent his messenger to show his servants the things that are given to happen soon.
And I come quickly: blessed is he who keeps the words of the prophecy of this book.
I am Yochanan, who saw and heard these things. And when I saw and heard, I fell down to worship before the feet of the messenger who showed me these things.
And he said to me: See, ‹you do it› not: I am your fellow-servant, and of your brothers the prophets, and of those who keep these words of this book. Worship Elohim.
And he said to me: Do not seal the words of the prophecy of this book, for the time is near.
